hints.title: Derangement Permutation Recurrence
hints.text: A derangement is a permutation where no element appears in its original index position.

hints.title: Subfactorial Two-Term Recurrence
hints.text: For element n, choosing one of n - 1 target spots leads either to swapping with partner D(n-2) or non-swapping D(n-1).

hints.title: Linear Space-Optimized Iteration
hints.text: Apply D(n) = (n - 1) * (D(n - 1) + D(n - 2)) % modulo 10^9 + 7 with base cases D(1) = 0 and D(2) = 1. Update variables iteratively in O(1) memory space.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in array
complexity.notes: Subfactorial dynamic programming computed in linear time with two variables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations and filtering valid derangements takes O(N * N!) factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-variable state maintenance requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: State the subfactorial recurrence D(n) = (n-1)*(D(n-1) + D(n-2)) and solve in O(1) space.
